findings.description: Registry-write-failure rollback is covered for removing the newly created worktree and branch, but the proposed acceptance text does not pin that the pre-existing worktrees registry remains intact after a failed write. A partial or truncated registry write would still satisfy 'no binding exists without its worktree' while breaking existing bindings and visibility.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit atomic-write requirement and fixture: seed an existing registry, simulate write failure during create, assert the old registry content remains readable and unchanged while the new worktree and branch are removed.

findings.description: F004 includes current_branch in the status model, but F007 only requires the brief and dashboard to render 'branch' plus health reasons. For branch-drifted bindings, the user-facing surfaces may show only the recorded branch and a generic drift reason, leaving the actual current branch invisible.
findings.recommendation: Pin renderer parity so list, brief, and dashboard all expose recorded branch and current_branch when they differ, or require the health reason payload to include the observed current branch value.
